ablation.name: local_t25_ll_cov_only
ablation.notes: T25: Plan G Covariance-Only LL WCT. Plan E(mean-only)失败:LPIPS对mean敏感. Plan F(std-only)失败:std破坏CLIP. Plan G测试最后一个未测统计量:cross-channel covariance(协方差). 仅迁移通道间色彩关系(如R-G相关性),保留content mean和std. _wct_match_fiber_keep_mean: WCT但加回content mean. 假设:CLIP正向(色彩关系迁移),LPIPS中性(亮度保留). 目标: clip>0.7213 AND lpips<0.2868 (dual beat T11).
